query: search= I am preparing a seminar talk for my reasoning course next week and I need to understand chain of thought prompting properly. As far as I know, the idea is that a large language model is shown a few examples where the answer is preceded by a series of short intermediate reasoning steps, and then it is asked a new question, so it writes its own steps before giving the final answer. I would like the original paper that introduced this idea, not later work on self consistency or tree of thoughts. I am especially curious about how many examples were placed in the prompt, which benchmarks were used, for example arithmetic word problems like GSM8K, commonsense questions and symbolic tasks such as last letter concatenation, and how large the improvement was compared with standard prompting. I also read that the benefit only appears when the model is big enough, around one hundred billion parameters, and that smaller models actually produce fluent but wrong reasoning. Could you confirm this and point me to the exact experiments that show it? Finally, I want to know whether the authors analysed which parts of the reasoning chain matter most, for example by removing the steps or replacing them with equations only, and what they concluded.

query: search= find papers similar to this description: Dense retrieval models usually need large datasets of queries paired with relevant documents for training, and they often perform poorly on new domains where no such labels exist. This work proposes a different route that needs no relevance labels at all. Given a user query, an instruction following language model is first asked to write a hypothetical document that would answer it. This generated document may contain factual mistakes, but it captures the kind of language and patterns that a real relevant document would have. The hypothetical document is then encoded with an unsupervised contrastive encoder, and its vector is used to search the real document collection, so the search is done document to document instead of query to document. The encoder acts as a lossy compressor that keeps the relevant meaning and filters out the invented details. Experiments cover web search, question answering and fact verification, as well as several low resource and non English retrieval tasks. The method clearly beats the unsupervised encoder used alone, and it is competitive with fine tuned retrievers on many datasets, even though it never sees a single labelled pair. I would like the original paper and a few later works that use generated documents or query expansion with large language models.

query: search= Halo, saya sedang mengerjakan proyek retrieval augmented generation untuk tugas akhir, dan saya menemukan masalah yang aneh. Ketika saya memasukkan banyak dokumen hasil retrieval ke dalam prompt model bahasa, model sering menjawab dengan benar kalau informasi pentingnya ada di dokumen pertama atau di dokumen terakhir, tetapi jawabannya sering salah kalau informasi tersebut berada di tengah konteks. Teman saya bilang ada paper terkenal yang meneliti fenomena ini secara sistematis dengan tugas question answering multi dokumen dan tugas pencarian key value sintetis, lalu menunjukkan bahwa kurva akurasinya berbentuk huruf U. Saya ingin membaca paper aslinya. Saya juga ingin tahu model apa saja yang diuji, apakah model dengan konteks yang lebih panjang benar-benar lebih baik dalam memakai informasi di tengah, dan apakah model encoder decoder berperilaku berbeda dibandingkan model decoder saja. Selain itu, saya penasaran apakah urutan dokumen, jumlah dokumen, dan query aware contextualization, yaitu menaruh pertanyaan sebelum dan sesudah dokumen, berpengaruh terhadap hasilnya. Saya juga berencana menguji fenomena ini sendiri dengan dataset berbahasa Indonesia. Terakhir, tolong carikan juga beberapa paper lanjutan yang mencoba memperbaiki masalah ini, misalnya dengan menyusun ulang dokumen, mengompres konteks, atau melatih model khusus untuk konteks panjang, supaya saya bisa memilih metode yang paling cocok untuk sistem saya dan menjelaskannya dengan baik di bab tinjauan pustaka.
